global_rules.hindsight: Outcome must never determine setup or execution quality.
global_rules.three_breaks: 3+ meaningful line breaks are an attention threshold, not automatic reversal.
global_rules.box_breaks: Line breaks inside liquidity boxes may be noise and should be weighted less than clean post-expansion breaks.
global_rules.momentum_shift: Can come from one very strong opposing candle or several strong opposing candles; not only line breaks.
global_rules.jpy_wicks: Allow somewhat more wick tolerance on JPY pairs.
global_rules.trigger_locality: Judge uniqueness relative to relevant local PPA, especially roughly 3–7 nearby candles.
global_rules.trigger_validity: Visual uniqueness OR structural dominance can validate; ideally both.
